lines.1: 「Maybe I should train my body a little...」
lines.4: Otome's eyes became those of a hawk sighting its prey.
lines.8: Even though I had not asked her.
lines.9: Otome's inner voice saying, 'Good. I will coach you.'
lines.10: 「First, show me the level of your basic fitness.」
